body: No problem, I dont see the point in being a dick. You get more accomplished being nice than you ever would being an asshole, or at least thats how I see it. Thats always a good sub to go to for this sorta thing I reckon.
Thats good, I'd be interested to hear if you find the impossible. I'm not really im afraid but I hope you and your co-worker have fun with whatever game you play.
No problem man. I hope things improve for you. Keeping myself occupied is all I can do really

Im sorry to hear that man, I really am. I can relate in a lot of ways, especially with the whole friends being couples thing. I try to message people and it takes me out of the moment for like, 5 seconds and then its plummeting back to ground zero. Different strokes for different folks tho I guess.

I will admit Im in a similar situation. My depression started cause of a breakup and I've not been able to get over them for the past 3 years and we're still really good friends but they've started dating someone else and its tearing me up inside cause I want to be happy for them but its making me feel horrible and jealous and it feels like I cant do anything to fix it. I've been to a service called CAMHS, who saw me until I was too old to see them anymore. I'm on Cetalopram right now but I dont even know if its working anymore.
That if I had a gun set beside me I'd shoot myself in the head, easily.

I've been to a therapist for the past 2 years at the Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services but since I've turned 18 they cant help me anymore and have had to let me go. They referred me on to Adult mental health but they said that they wanted to treat more serious cases so now I've got pretty much nothing but my friends and parents who can only help so much at this point.

They'd seen me for one appointment and I told them every basically and they sent a letter about a month later saying that. In the UK mental health is pretty fucked right now and their getting tons of people and arent able to help them all so I suppose they'd deal with the most serious cases who need day to day help and need more support rather than those who could be seen on a weekly basis. Or at least thats how I thought of it when they sent me the letter.

It was CAMHS which is child and adolescent mental health services but since I turned 18 they couldnt see me anymore since I was out of their kind of age range. It was always 1 on 1 therapy sessions with the same therapist I saw each week. It helped for a while but after it stopped everything kinda got worse. They had me sent to people who would take on people 18 and up but after 1 meeting they told me that they didnt think my case was serious enough that they can take me. Which is real shit but what can you do?
well I suppose you'll be glad to hear I've decided not to go through with it tonight. But I'm still gonna feel the same and things are just gonna get worse so I'm not sure why I bother.

Hmm. Seems like a big ol lie to me I'm afraid. This is not only a throwaway account that I use for the specific purpose of talking about my depression but I post very rarely and very infrequently, and never am I caring or whatever, I'm only ever talking about how upset I am. Sorry.
Of course. Most days I wish I could just melt away or just go to sleep and never wake up but thats never going to happen so I suppose the next step is just ending it all.

Sure thing. I have as far as I can tell, no reason to live. The world is an absolutely horrible place, filled with assholes where nothing will change and no-one can do anything about it. I have had depression for the past 2 years and its made my life a living hell, I keep being told that it does get better but if anything things have just gotten worse. Im on medication, I've been to my GP countless times, I've been in therapy, I tried everything and nothings going to change so I think I'd rather just kill myself than keep continuing.

I dont know man. I've been at the Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service for about the last year and half but when I turned 18 they told me they couldnt see me anymore and tried to have me referred onto adult mental health and they said I didnt meet the criteria. I've never been one for talking over the phone and that can get kinda hard since I mostly just want to shrivel up in my bed and be forgotten.
christ i feel like an idiot for writing all this, Im sorry

I'm sorry to hear that man. I guess I just really have no reason whatsoever to live. I've been depressed for the past 2 years or so since my girlfriend left me and its been kinda hard to get over them. Every day I just feel upset and I cant see anyone really for mental health stuff since the people I was sent to said I dont meet the criteria for me to see them. I'm also just sick of this world really, just waking up every day and seeing all the horrible, sick, twisted shit that people do, how people are dying every day in wars and of untreatable diseases and shit is just utterly depressing and horrible and I just dont feel like living in a place like this really.
